fields.name: moduleOne
fields.note: One of three values a client reports about software it has detected alongside itself: once, after it first finds such software, a number that software's name gives; zero otherwise.

fields.name: moduleTwo
fields.note: The second: that software's size as loaded, sent with the first; zero otherwise.

fields.name: moduleThree
fields.note: The third: when that software was built, sent with the first; zero otherwise.

fields.name: appearance
fields.note: The skin the client's own champion wears.

fields.name: appearanceCheck
fields.note: One of several values a client works out from that skin's content, picked at random for each message; zero where it has none.
